description: Policy for issuing bounded signed URLs for object-store backed artifact and report-output downloads.
rules: Signed URLs are built from an already authorized DownloadGrant.
base_url must use HTTPS and must not use localhost.
relative_path values must pass artifact storage path normalization.
expired download grants must not be signed.
signing_secret must be at least 32 characters and must never be included in the output URL.
signature covers path, backend, expires, disposition, and sha256.
Signed URL verification must reject missing signatures, duplicate query parameters, expired URLs, and tampered payloads.
filesystem grants continue to use platform_download_proxy rather than signed URLs.
